description: This file contains asynchronous functions for managing certification jobs, including creation, retrieval, patching, and listing related records such as audit logs, mappings, and metadata within a certification management system. It utilizes SQLAlchemy ORM models and integrates with pluggable repository adapters.

methods.description: Creates a new certification job, resolving repository info via adapter if necessary, and initializes related result rows.

methods.name: Optional[CertificationJob] get_certification_job_by_run_id(session: AsyncSession, run_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a certification job based on its run ID.

methods.name: Optional[CertificationJob] patch_certification_job(session: AsyncSession, run_id: str, patch: PatchCertificationRequest)
methods.description: Updates mutable fields of an existing certification job.

methods.name: List[BranchEnvironmentMapping] list_mappings(session: AsyncSession, provider: Optional[str] = None, project_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Lists branch-environment mappings with optional filters.

methods.name: BranchEnvironmentMapping create_mapping(session: AsyncSession, item: Dict[str, Any])
List[MetadataItem] list_metadata(session: AsyncSession, filters: Dict[str, Optional[str]])

methods.name: MetadataItem upsert_metadata(session: AsyncSession, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Inserts or updates metadata items based on provided payload.
